prompt:
Design a vibrant promotional poster for the grand opening of Brew & Bloom Cafe. Show beautifully presented cappuccino, fresh croissants, desserts, and a cozy modern cafe interior.

Headline: BREW & BLOOM
Tagline: Your New Favorite Coffee Spot!
Grand Opening: 15 October 2026.
Special Offer: Buy 1 Get 1 Free.
Highlights: Fresh Coffee, Artisan Desserts, Cozy Ambience.
Address: FC Road, Pune.
Contact: +91 98765 12345
Website: [www.brewandbloom.in](http://www.brewandbloom.in)

CTA: VISIT US TODAY!

Use warm brown, cream, and pastel green tones, stylish typography, appetizing food photography, and an inviting contemporary layout.
name: brew_bloom_warm_mosaic
idea: A warm cream editorial poster pairing a generous brown serif text column with an organic four-photo cafe mosaic. Pastel green offer and CTA panels, a handwritten arrow, and subtle texture make the opening feel welcoming.
